provenance.bounded_access: Only ten explicit target loci were materialized by selector-first TSV guard; cached JSON retrieval returned only those same loci. No target from another paragraph was output or stored by the acquisition script.

representation.raw_groups: Every ivtff_group_raw and both separator fields are copied literally. No entity resolution, spelling normalization, punctuation erasure, joining, splitting or conversion to clean ASCII forms. Source IDs and all available source metadata retained.
representation.display_only_space_joined: A convenience display; plain spaces do not assert definite word boundaries. The group separator fields are authoritative.
representation.complete_unit: ZL3b and IT2a have source start/end flags for both exact spans. RF1b has no source paragraph flags; matching line spans are supplied without claiming complete RF paragraphs.
representation.alternatives: Three editorial readings of one manuscript, not independent experimental replications. cpho[s:r] and @entities remain unresolved raw forms.

bounded_consistency_findings.detail: P05 PRODUCER_DRAFT prints cphos; ZL source group 2 is literally cpho[s:r]. IT has cphor and RF cphos. This packet does not choose s or r.
ZL has cpho plus l separated by UNCERTAIN_SMALL_SPACE. IT and RF each have cphol as one group. RAW370 separate TRITURATE/TO alignment relies on the ZL group hypothesis.
ZL fcho plus kshy has UNCERTAIN_SMALL_SPACE; IT and RF have fchokshy. ZL/RF sheol, opsheas differ from IT cheol, opcheas.
ZL sh plus cthey has UNCERTAIN_SMALL_SPACE; IT has shcthey; RF has sh and cthey with definite separation.
ZL chy plus ky has UNCERTAIN_SMALL_SPACE; IT retains two definitely separated groups; RF has chyky.
ZL begins ykeey and has ysheol at group 4; IT begins ykeea and has ysheol; RF begins ykee@222; and has @222;sheol. No automatic lexical equivalence assigned.
ZL/RF otshcho and r are separate groups, IT has otshchor. ZL/IT dain differs from RF daii. All readings retain a drawing interruption after ZL/IT dain or RF daii, without assigning it a meaning.
ZL ctho plus daiin has UNCERTAIN_SMALL_SPACE; IT has two definite groups, RF cthodaiin. ZL/IT d differs from RF @152;. ZL/RF shan differs from IT shar. Drawing interruptions retained.
Exact chor chol daiin appears with definite internal separators in all three readings at both loci. This does not identify meanings, physical ownership, recipe continuity or independent witnesses.

interpretation: Acquisition and internal source consistency only. No translation, parser, material continuity, causal ordering, confirmed word meanings or experimental PASS is established.
